children: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Sept. 18, 2026
-- Rubicon Organics Inc.
OTCQX:ROMJF

(“Rubicon Organics” or the “Company”), Canada’s leading premium licensed producer focused on cultivating and selling premium and super-premium cannabis products, is pleased to announce the launch of 1964 Supply Co.™ (“1964”) full spectrum vapes in the United Kingdom through its distribution partnership with 4C LABS.

“The response to 1964 in the U.K. has demonstrated that there is growing demand for premium medical cannabis products in international markets,” said Margaret Brodie, Chief Executive Officer of Rubicon Organics. “With patient numbers in the U.K. expected to grow 40% this year1, and vape offerings increasingly popular, the launch of 1964 full spectrum vapes builds on the success of the brand in the U.K. and further strengthens our position in a rapidly expanding market.”

1964 first entered the U.K. market with its award-winning Blue Dream and Stinky Pinky flower strains in April. Rubicon Organics has since expanded the brand's flower offerings to include its Apples and Bananas flower, and the launch of full spectrum vapes marks the next step in developing the 1964 portfolio for the U.K. medical cannabis market. By extending its premium genetics into vape formats, 1964 provides patients with additional consumption options beyond flower while maintaining the quality, consistency, and cultivar-driven experience associated with the brand.

1964 is one of Rubicon Organics’ flagship brands and one of Canada’s leading premium cannabis brands, having won numerous awards including Brand of the Year for the last two years at the industry’s prestigious KIND Awards. The brand is inspired by classic legacy genetics and designed to deliver genuine, high-quality cannabis with a focus on consistency and trust.
ABOUT RUBICON ORGANICS INC.

Rubicon Organics is the Canadian leader in certified organic and premium cannabis. With a vertically integrated model and strong national distribution, the company is scaling a house of trusted, high-performing brands including Simply Bare™ Organic, 1964 Supply Co.™, Wildflower™, and Homestead Cannabis Supply™.

The Company operates two complementary cultivation facilities in British Columbia: the flagship 125,000 square foot Pacifica hybrid greenhouse in Delta and the 47,500 square foot Cascadia indoor facility in Hope. Cascadia is now fully planted and operational, contributing to Rubicon’s total current annual production capacity of approximately 15,500 kilograms of premium cannabis.
With proprietary genetics, award-winning products, and certifications enabling international distribution, Rubicon is positioned at the forefront of the premium cannabis segment.

As the Canadian market continues to evolve and global demand for high-quality cannabis increases, Rubicon Organics’ disciplined execution, brand equity, and consumer loyalty set it apart. The Company’s continued focus on premium quality, thoughtful innovation, and operational excellence has supported steady revenue growth and positive Adjusted EBITDA.
Rubicon Organics represents a rare combination of category leadership, operational strength, and long-term growth potential.

ABOUT 4C LABS

4C LABS Ltd. is a privately held Canadian medical cannabis company focusing on providing pharmacies & clinics with world class medical cannabis products at an affordable price. 4C LABS has import and distribution licenses in the UK and a wide network of pharmacies in the UK & Channel Islands. 4C LABS carries a full product line of medical cannabis from a selected network of trusted international cultivation partners.
